primary_structure: Keep one enormous black block headline as a primary shape, preferably left-heavy for horizontal formats and upper-heavy for vertical formats.
Place the 3D subject cluster close to the viewer, offset from the type mass, with a low wide-angle perspective.
Use a pale studio floor and wall with soft shadows so the black type and lime accents remain crisp.
Add acid-lime fabric, product trim, marker strokes, or ground elements as a repeated accent field.
Scatter small sticker badges, warning marks, barcodes, tags, and seals around the main action in controlled clusters.
Use tactile props at the foreground edge, including tools, boxes, bags, cables, fabric, brushes, or fashion accessories.
Keep the main type readable and do not bury it behind too many props.
Maintain a campaign-poster balance between clean negative space and dense accessory detail.
composition.vertical_9x16: Use a stacked poster composition: black headline in the upper half, 3D subject in the center or lower-right, exaggerated foreground prop at the bottom, and lime ground accents crossing the lower third.
composition.horizontal_16x9: Use a split campaign layout: black headline mass across the left half, 3D subject and prop cluster on the right, with marker strokes and badges bridging the middle.

typography.headline: Oversized condensed black block display type, tightly stacked, squared, heavy, and slightly compressed, with a bold streetwear poster feel.
typography.secondary_text: Short supporting text in black-on-lime strips, white-on-black labels, or small rounded sans-serif tags.
typography.text_orientation: Main type is mostly horizontal and stacked; marker scribbles can cross it diagonally; micro labels may tilt or attach to props.
typography.text_behavior: Use only replacement text supplied by the case values. Keep it short, readable, and graphic; never include source slogans, platform names, watermarks, usernames, or real app marks.

color_palette.behavior: Use pale gray and off-white as the spatial field, black as the typographic anchor, acid lime as the primary pop color, and only tiny high-chroma stickers for secondary accents.

image_treatment.rendering_mode: Polished C4D 3D illustration blended with graphic poster typography and sticker design.
image_treatment.surface_quality: Smooth toy-like character surfaces, tactile textile weave, glossy black rubber, chrome rails or hardware, semi-translucent acrylic, and printed sticker paper.
image_treatment.lighting: High-key synthetic studio light with soft floor shadows, controlled highlights, gentle bloom, and crisp edge clarity.
image_treatment.depth: Short studio-stage depth with oversized foreground props, central subject, stacked boxes or bags behind, and flat headline wall space.
image_treatment.post_processing: Clean sharp high-resolution commercial finish, minimal grain, no rough analog distress, high contrast between black type and pale background.

Make the headline a massive black graphic block and keep it more important than small captions.
Use low wide-angle perspective so at least one foreground prop or body part feels exaggerated and close.
Repeat acid-lime accents through marker strokes, textile fields, tags, object trim, or sticker details.
Use sticker badges, barcodes, warning triangles, scalloped seals, and capsule labels as a controlled graphic grammar.
Keep the 3D subject toy-like, polished, and fashion-editorial rather than photoreal or anime.

title: Amber Orbit Editorial
description: Intimate warm macro photography, grazing amber light, ivory serif typography and fine overlapping orbital lines turn tactile details into quiet editorial stories about attention, making and time.
author: VigoZhao

variables.name: STYLE_FIDELITY_ANCHORS
variables.defaultValue: [CORE] Let one intimate, oversized photographic detail dominate the frame; render it as a tangible surface with real depth, an assertive crop and selective focal clarity. [CORE] Keep a continuous warm tonal family of ivory, sand, honey amber, tobacco and deep brown, with luminous grazing highlights against quiet, sufficiently dark regions for pale lettering. [CORE] Pair fine ivory high-contrast serif display lettering with small, restrained sans-serif supporting copy; preserve a quiet editorial hierarchy and ample breathing room. [CORE] Overlay a small family of hairline, translucent ivory circles or circular arcs, nested, offset or tangent, that visibly relate to a meaningful contour or action in the photograph. [CORE] Preserve tactile microtexture at the focal plane, gentle optical softness elsewhere and a few subtle horizontal light-drag veils across peripheral photo areas; keep the graphic lines and wording clear. [FLEX] Let the subject's meaning determine the geometry: circles can suggest listening, rotation, refraction or unfolding, with projected ellipses permitted when motivated by photographic perspective. [FLEX] Reposition subject, headline and annotations for each case and ratio; asymmetry, edge bleed and off-center visual balance may change freely while the warm photographic and ivory-line family stays recognizable. [FLEX] Choose title line breaks and annotation placement for the available quiet space; labels may follow the orbital rhythm without forcing a fixed top-to-bottom timeline or copying the source.

raw.style_name: Blue Chinese Perspective Type Canyon Style
raw.style_summary: A Chinese typographic poster system built from an extreme one-point perspective corridor: a saturated blue central trapezoid plane carries stacked oversized white Chinese display type, while black side walls are packed with warped white and pale gray Chinese support copy.

visual_deconstruction.composition_logic: The image is built as a Chinese typographic tunnel. The central plane is a saturated blue tapered rectangle in one-point perspective; the side planes are black walls angled toward a narrow vanishing point. Cropped Chinese letterforms at the edges increase the sense of scale.
visual_deconstruction.subject_placement: The subject is mostly typographic. The biggest Chinese glyph or numeric element sits near the lower foreground, while the headline and smaller supporting blocks recede upward along the blue center plane.
visual_deconstruction.camera_perspective: Low, close, wide-angle one-point perspective with converging vertical side walls and a compressed vanishing area near the upper center.
visual_deconstruction.typographic_behavior: Bold Chinese display glyphs, heavy geometric numerals, and compact Chinese support copy are treated as architecture. Type is skewed, stacked, cropped, and repeated.
visual_deconstruction.surface_behavior: Planes are clean and flat, but white letters carry light gray shading or beveled tonal variation that makes them read as flat 3D signage.
visual_deconstruction.mood: Urgent, loud, compressed, retail-advertising energy with a blue central sign corridor instead of the source red corridor.

composition.primary_structure: A central saturated blue trapezoid or vertical runway creates the main path from bottom foreground to top vanishing point.
composition.secondary_structure: Black side walls fill the left and right thirds and converge toward the top center, carrying dense distorted Chinese supporting type.
composition.foreground_scale: At least one huge white Chinese word, number, or block glyph should be cropped by the bottom or side edge.
composition.depth_rules: Elements must shrink rapidly toward the vanishing point. Side text should look attached to wall planes, not floating.
composition.cropping_rules: Large edge-cropped Chinese characters are required on both side walls and optional on the central blue plane.

typography.type_style: Ultra-bold Chinese display type, heavy geometric numerals, blocky sans-serif glyphs, and small compressed Chinese support copy.
typography.layout: Stack the main Chinese headline vertically or in compact blocks on the blue plane; pack side walls with angled repetitions and fragments.
typography.weight: Use very heavy weights for primary Chinese words and numbers; secondary text may be thinner but still condensed and graphic.
typography.distortion: Perspective warp is mandatory. Letters should stretch, taper, and crop according to their wall plane.
typography.readability: Exact text accuracy is less important than the feeling of loud Chinese commercial typography; use clear headline fragments where possible.

color_palette.proportions: Blue should dominate the center plane, black should dominate the side walls, and white/gray Chinese typography should cover most visible surfaces.
color_palette.contrast: High contrast only. Avoid mid-color palettes and decorative gradients.
color_palette.accents: No extra accent colors unless the case absolutely requires one, and then only as a tiny mark.

image_treatment.rendering_mode: Crisp flat 3D typographic poster render, vector-like planes, hard edges, subtle tonal shading on white Chinese letters.
image_treatment.texture: Mostly smooth digital poster finish, with optional faint print softness or slight edge anti-aliasing.
image_treatment.lighting: Simple frontal or overhead graphic lighting, no realistic shadows except mild plane shading.
image_treatment.finish: Sharp, high-contrast, poster-ready raster output with no photo grain, no realistic environment, and no hand-drawn texture.

design_rules: Always preserve the blue central perspective plane and black typographic side walls
Always use oversized white or pale gray Chinese type as the main visual material
Keep the camera inside the corridor, close to the foreground, with a strong top-center vanishing point
Use dense supporting Chinese typography on both sides so the image feels loud and compressed
Change the event topic and text content for each case while keeping the same spatial grammar
Use numeric emphasis in at least some cases, but avoid the original price and original hour-count story
do: Use a narrow Chinese type canyon with strong one-point perspective
Use a huge foreground Chinese word, number, or glyph on the blue central plane
Use warped Chinese side-wall text fragments that are cropped by the frame
Use only blue, black, white, and gray
Make the poster feel urgent, compressed, and typographically overloaded
avoid: Avoid realistic people, realistic products, interior decor, shop shelves, or photographic scenes
Avoid red center panels, pastel colors, gradients, neon multicolor palettes, beige paper, or multicolor illustration
Avoid flat front-facing flyer layouts without depth
Avoid thin elegant type, serif editorial typography, or casual handwriting
Avoid copying the original bargain-sale text, price, dates, or countdown premise
Avoid logos, watermarks, QR codes, UI chrome, or platform marks

Accent symbol: {ACCENT_SYMBOL}. Wardrobe or styling direction: {WARDROBE_STYLE}. Aspect ratio: {ASPECT_RATIO}. Preserve these style fidelity anchors: {STYLE_FIDELITY_ANCHORS}. Avoid this source content: {SOURCE_CONTENT_TO_AVOID}. Build the composition as an extreme one-point perspective Chinese typographic corridor: a saturated electric blue central trapezoid plane recedes toward the upper-center vanishing point, with black left and right walls covered in skewed white and pale gray Chinese type fragments. Use huge cropped white Chinese block glyphs or numerals in the foreground, stacked central Chinese headline type on the blue plane, and dense warped side-wall support copy. Keep the palette strictly blue, black, white, and gray. Use clean flat 3D poster rendering, hard-edged vector-like planes, mild gray shading on white Chinese letters, very high contrast, no realistic people, no photographic products, no extra colors, no logos, no watermark. The image should feel like a loud compressed advertising tunnel made entirely from Chinese typography and perspective.
